description: Water Supply Main Pipelines is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Layer containing water main centre lines and associated details. Includes water main name, description, asset section (for As Constructed drawings) and key attributes for water transfer pipes, bypass connections, aqueducts. Coverage: Melbourne. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are assets, mains, melbourne-water, transfer-network, water-supply. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
